title: Ask for a relay key (POST /api/tournaments/:slug/relay-keys body)
description: Sender: OpenPairings, for its hall box (Alnasl). Same credentials as a publish: Authorization: Bearer <operator ingest token | owning installation key> (a relay key is the anonymous 401), X-OpenResults-Key: the tournament's key once claimed. Asking again under the same label ROTATES: the publisher's earlier key under that label is revoked. Extra fields are ignored. DELETE on the same path (optional ?label=) revokes the publisher's keys; see relay-key-revoke.response.schema.json.

label.description: Optional; control characters become spaces, trimmed, at most 80 characters kept. Blank or absent means "publisher".
